source: O*NET Online (https://www.onetonline.org/) -- public domain data published by the U.S. Department of Labor / Employment and Training Administration (USDOL/ETA).
subset_rationale: Five domains amenable to objective, file/output-based evaluation in this MVP. Soft domains (Legal, Communication, Education) are deferred until an LLM-as-judge scoring path is added.

domains.name: Computer & Mathematical
domains.description: Occupations centred on software engineering, scripting, data structures, algorithms, and quantitative reasoning. The natural baseline for an agent with terminal + file tools.

domains.name: Office & Administrative
domains.description: Document processing, structured note-taking, scheduling artefacts, form completion. Tasks produce well-formed files whose structure can be checked deterministically.

domains.name: Business & Financial
domains.description: Budgeting, financial calculations, structured report generation. Numeric correctness is checkable with tolerance-based comparison against ground-truth values.

domains.name: Management
domains.description: Project plans, resource-allocation artefacts, risk registers, milestone schedules. Evaluated by structural rubric (required sections, required content present).

domains.name: Data Analysis
domains.description: Cleaning datasets, producing summary statistics, generating structured outputs (CSV/JSON), validating against expected numerical results.
